reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: src/charset.rs owns static classification tables and xbuffers for user-defined ranges; wchar_range_table views borrow the corresponding xbuffer data and count rather than duplicate ownership.
owner_creation.invariant: Each published range-table view must match its backing xbuffer.
limitations: Image literal ranges and allocated user ranges have different release rules.

aliases_escapes.analysis: src/charset.rs prchar and prutfchar return pointers into separate static 32-byte scratch buffers. setfmt also retains an interior pointer into caller/environment format text without copying it.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Scratch results expire logically on the next formatter use.
limitations: A stable static address is not stable formatted content.

callback_targets.analysis: src/charset.rs calls setlocale and formatting functions directly; init_charset obtains format strings from lgetenv and passes them to setfmt. It stores format text, not a function callback.
callback_targets.invariant: Retained format text needs a lifetime compatible with global use.
limitations: This review does not rederive native variadic-format ABI correctness.

invalidation.analysis: src/charset.rs publishes user range-table views only after appending ranges, while scratch printers overwrite their static arrays on each call. Reinitializing backing xbuffers would invalidate earlier range views.
invalidation.invariant: Readers must not retain a view across backing reinitialization.
limitations: Repeated initialization is a conditional contract concern, not a newly observed leak.

mutation_commit.analysis: src/charset.rs changes attribute and format-pointer outputs separately in setfmt, and user range parsing appends one range at a time before final view publication. This is not a transactional configuration owner.
mutation_commit.invariant: Format attributes and text must describe the same completed configuration.
limitations: Default-format validation does not provide owner exclusion.

release_pair.analysis: src/charset.rs range descriptors borrow xbuffer storage and cannot free it themselves; static printer arrays likewise must never be allocator-released. init resets descriptors without an in-file retirement transaction.
release_pair.invariant: Only the backing xbuffer owner can release allocated range bytes.
limitations: No final free or safe repeated-init lifecycle is inferred for global user ranges.

error_cleanup.analysis: src/charset.rs malformed UTF range syntax reports an error and quits after already initialized buffers or earlier appended ranges. The routine offers no local rollback object for those partial owners.
error_cleanup.invariant: A fatal parse path is distinct from a recoverable staged configuration result.
limitations: No allocation-failure execution was performed for these initialization branches.

signals_handoff.analysis: src/charset.rs shared formatting arrays, format pointers and range views rely on ordinary serialized configuration/use. M0-MEM-001 remains open; there is no handler registration or exclusion token in these APIs.
signals_handoff.invariant: A formatter borrow must not overlap another write to its scratch owner.
limitations: No specific signal route into range reconfiguration is established here.
